description: Two delay lines for control voltages, each with a plain delayed output and a send that can carry either the delayed or the undelayed signal

params.text: Sets that row's delay, 0 to 10 seconds, read out in milliseconds on the display above it
Chooses what that row's SND jack carries: PRE the incoming signal, POST the delayed one

inputs.text: Added to that row's TIME MS knob, a second per volt

outputs.text: Carries either the incoming or the delayed signal for that row, whichever the PRE and POST switch is set to
The delayed signal for that row

notes: A row delays by up to 10 seconds; patch one row's output into another Signal Delay's input to chain them for a longer delay.
